test.js: Test file for a local PDF generation module (`./index`). Defines an HTML template with Handlebars syntax, sets PDF options (A3, portrait, border, custom header/footer with page numbers), and generates a PDF file from dynamic user data. Exports none; used for manual testing. Relies on an external PDF library (e.g., html-pdf). Key search terms: HTML to PDF, header footer, Handlebars, pdfkit, page numbers.
index.js: This file generates PDFs from HTML templates. It exports an async function `(doc, options)` returning a Promise. It validates required `doc.html` and `doc.data`, compiles the template with Handlebars, and uses `html-pdf` to create and save the file. Only PDF output is supported. Error handling uses `cli-error-handler`. Key concepts: html-pdf, Handlebars template to PDF, PDF generation, CLI error handler.
readme.md: pdf-node is a JavaScript PDF generation library for Node.js. It creates PDFs from HTML templates with Handlebars-like syntax. The main exported method is `pdf.create(document, options)`. Business logic: reads an HTML template, injects user data via Handlebars placeholders, and generates a PDF with configurable format (A3, Letter, etc.), orientation, borders, headers, and footers. External references: Handlebars.js. Key search concepts: PDF generation, Node.js, HTML to PDF, Handlebars templates, pdf-create.
todo.md: Markdown TODO file noting a pending task to add support for stream and binary data. No classes, functions, or exports defined. Serves as a development reminder rather than executable logic. Key search concepts: stream, binary, todo.
package-lock.json: This is the `package-lock.json` for the `pdf-node` project (v1.0.0, MIT). It locks dependency versions for reproducible installs. Production dependencies: `cli-error-handler` (CLI error formatting), `handlebars` (templating), `html-pdf` (HTML-to-PDF conversion). Dev dependency: `prettier` (code formatter). Also lists many transitive dependencies like `ajv`, `chalk`, etc. No custom classes or functions; purely dependency management. Key search terms: npm package-lock, pdf generation, handlebars templates, html-pdf, cli error handler.
package.json: A Node.js package.json for the `pdf-node` library, a PDF generator using HTML templates. It depends on `html-pdf` (HTML-to-PDF conversion) and `Handlebars` (templating). Entry point: `index.js`. Scripts include `start`, `test`, and `format` (Prettier). Exports no classes; key symbols are the npm package name and CLI error handler. Business logic: generate PDFs from HTML. External: html-pdf, Handlebars. Search keywords: node pdf generator, html2pdf, htmltopdf, node pdf from html, node pdf converter.
